Body assembly: 490 × 490 mm. Lids: 498 × 498 mm. Max closed height 226 mm; excludes drums and hardware.
Design intent: sustained rain/splash. No claimed IP rating. Validate seals, printed walls and cooling before service.
Print the small seal-test kit first. Confirm TPU hardness and saltwater exposure before finalising materials.
